splits.rule: Rows are assigned by instance_date. A boundary date belongs entirely to the later slice. Hyperparameters use only the training period, with early stopping on the inner training tail. Calibration is fit on val_fit and chosen on val_sel. Conformal scores use val_conf. The test period is not used to fit, stop, calibrate, or select.

history_rule: Community, building, project, property-type, and bedroom statistics are computed from earlier calendar months only. The current month is excluded. Rare building, project, landmark, metro, and mall labels are grouped using training-period frequencies only. Unseen labels become __OTHER__. Missing labels stay __MISSING__.
